title: Mango Lassi
description: Ripe mango blended with yogurt, cold milk, and a pinch of cardamom until thick and frothy.
notes: Tinned Alphonso or Kesar pulp gives the most reliable result outside mango season.

steps.text: Blend the mango pulp, yogurt, milk, sugar, and cardamom until smooth and frothy.
steps.tip: Taste before adding the sugar — tinned pulp is usually sweetened already.

steps.text: Add the ice cubes and blend again briefly. Pour into chilled glasses and top with a few threads of saffron.
